title: The Bitter Encore of Oakhaven Row
motive_summary: Romantic Betrayal / Jealousy (Using social humiliation to mask emotional violence)
overview_text: The discovery was made in 'Cafe Storage Room'. The air inside was thick and heavy, smelling faintly of dust and stale cigar smoke mixed with the metallic tang of blood. Isabella Reed found the body of Elias Grant slumped awkwardly near a stack of discarded props from the failed prank. The manner of death was precise, suggesting deep knowledge of anatomy, achieved by force using 'Brass till weight'. It looked less like a crime of passion and more like a calculated silencing.
